mapper.select: SELECT sdc.id, sdc.name, sdc.code, sdc.description, sdc.status, sdc.extend_schema, sdc.sort_order, sdc.created_at, creator.nickname as created_by_name, sdc.updated_at, updater.nickname as updated_by_name FROM sys_dict_category sdc LEFT JOIN users creator ON sdc.created_by = creator.id LEFT JOIN users updater ON sdc.updated_by = updater.id WHERE sdc.id = #{id} AND sdc.delflag = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_dict_category SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND delflag = 0
